outcomes.resolution_summary: The OSIRIS-REx sample-return capsule landed safely in Utah on 2023-09-24, making the retained September recovery plan the outcome-aligned action.

authoritative_sources.title: OSIRIS-REx Earth Return and Entry: Targeting Strategy and Maneuver Performance

cruxes.description: Whether trajectory correction and navigation would place the capsule inside the atmospheric-entry corridor.
Whether the spacecraft would release the sample capsule at the planned state while diverting the carrier safely past Earth.
Whether the heat shield, parachutes, and landing sequence would perform through atmospheric entry and descent.
Whether weather, range coordination, recovery teams, and clean-room handling would support immediate retrieval and curation.

outcomes.resolution_summary: Artemis I did not launch during August or September 2022; SLS and Orion launched on 2022-11-16, so rebaselining the primary launch plan beyond September was the outcome-aligned action.

authoritative_sources.title: Liftoff! NASA's Artemis I Mega Rocket Launches Orion to Moon

cruxes.description: Whether the first integrated SLS, Orion, and ground-systems stack would remain flight-ready through final countdown operations.
Whether propellant loading, thermal conditioning, and engine-start constraints could be satisfied during the available launch windows.
Whether weather, range, and pad constraints would leave a usable launch opportunity before the end of September.
Whether teams could diagnose issues, service the vehicle, and recycle between attempts within the September horizon.
